epic.title: stop-hook-door-binding
epic.intent_and_why: Let the Stop hook's mid-flight refusal see a spine claimed through the MCP door, not only through a Bash checklist_engine.py claim, so a Commander whose spine is driven entirely via spine_lease/spine_start/spine_advance cannot silently end its turn mid-gate believing a backgrounded command will resume it.

definition_of_done: handle_post_tool_use records a session->spine binding for a door-issued spine_lease claim/release
decide_stop refuses a door-claimed mid-flight turn-end (RED, independently reproduced twice)
a legitimate door-claimed turn-end is not refused (CONTROL, 4 cases)
a malformed door payload records no binding and raises nothing (fail-open proof)
the Bash checklist_engine.py claim/release path is unchanged in behavior

good_enough.mandatory_quality: Fail-open always; no new subprocess; narrow matcher, not '*'; Bash path byte-for-byte unchanged
good_enough.sufficient_evidence: RED + CONTROL + fail-open unit tests over the pure handler functions, plus the full clean-env suite green

hard_constraints: no new subprocess on the PostToolUse path
file ownership limited to scripts/hooks/spine_rail.py, tests/test_spine_rail.py, and the PostToolUse block of .claude/settings.json
fixed_decisions: door path resolves the claimed spine from this process's own SPINE_FILE/SPINE_SESSION environment, reusing _is_valid_claim_target unchanged
matcher scoped to mcp__spine__spine_lease only, not the whole mcp__spine__* namespace and not '*'

current_wave.objective: Close the MCP-door Stop-hook binding gap named in LAUNCH_ORDER.md
exit_criteria: RED and CONTROL and fail-open proofs all pass

issues.title: Record a binding on door-issued spine_lease claim/release
issues.desired_outcome: The Stop hook's existing mid-flight refusal fires for a door-claimed spine exactly as it already does for a Bash-claimed one.
issues.useful_now: Six Commander dispatches were lost today to auto-backgrounding because the door path left no binding for decide_stop to check; the refusal mechanism already exists and works, it just could not see the door.
issues.acceptance_or_falsification_evidence: tests/test_spine_rail.py's new door-path tests (RED/CONTROL/fail-open) pass; the full suite stays green.
issues.implementation_latitude: Choose the exact helper structure and test layout; the design itself (fail-open, no subprocess, narrow matcher, SPINE_FILE-sourced resolution) is fixed by LAUNCH_ORDER.md.

parked_possibilities: extending the same door-binding recognition to mcp__spine-epic__spine_lease, if it is ever reachable from this repo's own configuration

completed_outcomes.outcome: handle_post_tool_use dispatches a new _handle_door_lease helper on tool_name == "mcp__spine__spine_lease", before the existing Bash command-extraction logic; it resolves the claimed spine from this process's own SPINE_FILE/SPINE_SESSION environment, reuses _is_valid_claim_target unchanged, and records/removes a binding entry equivalent in shape to the Bash-path entry. decide_stop/_mid_flight_reason are unchanged and now refuse a door-claimed mid-flight turn-end because a binding exists. .claude/settings.json gained one narrow PostToolUse matcher entry (mcp__spine__spine_lease).
completed_outcomes.evidence: python -m pytest -q tests/test_spine_rail.py -> 139 passed, 1 skipped (was 123 passed, 1 skipped before this gate; +16 new tests, 0 regressions). RED independently reproduced twice (Commander and Reviewer, both via git stash push/pop on scripts/hooks/spine_rail.py alone). Reviewer verdict APPROVE (.agent-work/stop-hook-door-binding/crew-handoffs/g1-review-reviewer-result.md).

wave_evidence.expected: decide_stop returns a block decision naming the open gate.
wave_evidence.observed: test_stop_door_claimed_mid_flight_blocks passes post-fix; independently reproduced as genuinely FAILING pre-fix via git stash (twice, by two independent agents).

A malformed door payload records no binding and raises nothing.
wave_evidence.expected: handle_post_tool_use returns {} for every malformed shape, never raises.
wave_evidence.observed: 7 distinct malformed-shape tests plus a 7-row x 2-env-state fuzz test all pass.

wave_evidence.claim: The Bash checklist_engine.py claim/release path is unchanged in behavior.
wave_evidence.expected: Every pre-existing test passes with unmodified assertions; decide_stop/_mid_flight_reason/decide_session_start are byte-identical to HEAD.
wave_evidence.observed: git diff --numstat shows scripts/hooks/spine_rail.py +105/-0 and tests/test_spine_rail.py +209/-0 -- purely additive. Reviewer hashed the three Stop-path functions byte-identical to HEAD.
